# Ricardo Silva - Computer Systems Engineering Graduate

Portfolio of Ricardo Silva, a Computer Systems Engineering graduate and Master's student in Computer Science at IPCA, based in Guimarães, Portugal. His experience includes services and materials operations, retail product management and purchasing, inventory, and pricing.

## Site Structure
- `/`: Introduction, professional focus, current projects, and experience.
- `/about`: Background, education, professional experience, languages, and approach to people, processes, and operations.
- `/interests`: Focus areas in people management, process coordination, and continuous improvement.
- `/projects`: Current systems engineering projects and selected earlier work.

## Professional Focus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Systems Engineering, completed in 2026. Currently pursuing a Master's in Computer Science at IPCA.
Languages: Portuguese (native), English (B2), and German (A1; currently learning).
Aiming to pursue a double-degree pathway with one year at IPCA and one year in Austria at FHV - Vorarlberg University of Applied Sciences.
Professional experience includes services and materials operations, product management, purchasing, inventory, pricing, and process optimization.
Based in Guimarães, Portugal.

## Current Projects
- Orthopaedic X-ray measurement assistant: in development to help orthopaedic clinicians identify the appropriate X-ray reference and calculate measurements automatically to support productivity. Intended as a clinician-support tool.
- Textile company ERP: in development, focused on user-friendly workflows and comprehensive manuals explaining each task and how to complete it.
